data.title: Camelia Townhouses
data.about:
Damac Hills 2 provides you a variety of family-friendly amenities that will keep you and your loved ones entertained for a lifetime. Camelia townhouses are everlasting in Design and feature exciting waterpark amenities allowing you to create the destiny you’ve always desired – for you and those who matter the most.

Each townhouse has a stunning exterior that displays luxury living at its finest, offering 3 bedrooms that can be expanded to 4 bedrooms. You can expect an abundance of space, both inside and out. This stunning neighborhood is located in the heart of Dubai, close to major road networks and easily accessible.

characteristics_module.title: A home dreams are built upon
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exciting water feature amenities
  • 3 Bedroom townhouses expandable to 4 Bedroom
  • Strategically located in Damac Hills 2
  • Adventure sport facilities
  • Price starting from 1.3M AED
  • 70/30 Payment plan

location_tile.title: The Strategic Location
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description: The strategic position of Camelia Townhouses makes it easy to access four major highways and other roadways leading into the city. After 25 minutes of driving on Al Qudra Road, you will reach Damac Hills 2.
